entities.summary: DeMarcus Walker is an American professional football defensive end. He played college football for the Florida State Seminoles and was selected by the Denver Broncos in the second round of the 2017 NFL draft. Walker has also played for the Houston Texans, Tennessee Titans, and Chicago Bears.
